mapper.insert: INSERT INTO graph_maintenance_run (run_type, status, requested_by) VALUES (#{runType}, #{status}, #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_type, status, cursor_achievement_id, scanned_count, repaired_count, difference_count, requested_by, error_code, error_summary, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM graph_maintenance_run WHERE id = #{runId}

SELECT id, run_type, status, cursor_achievement_id, scanned_count, repaired_count, difference_count, requested_by, error_code, error_summary, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM graph_maintenance_run WHERE run_type = #{runType} AND status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE graph_maintenance_run SET status = 'PENDING', requested_by = #{requestedBy}, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'FAILED'
UPDATE graph_maintenance_run SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE graph_maintenance_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE graph_maintenance_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT desired_version FROM graph_projection_state WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId}
mapper.update: UPDATE graph_maintenance_run SET cursor_achievement_id = #{cursor}, scanned_count = scanned_count + #{scanned}, repaired_count = repaired_count + #{repaired}, difference_count = difference_count + #{differences} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_type, status, cursor_achievement_id, scanned_count, repaired_count, difference_count, requested_by, error_code, error_summary, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM graph_maintenance_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
